requested_outcome: Responsive business performance with progressive sections, bounded rows and complete totals, sorting, CSV and detail access
authorization_boundary: Repair and publish under standing VII authorization. No supplier bulk refresh, bookings, leads, messages or provider changes.

lesson_bundle.reason: Pagination must preserve complete report truth
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Compare totals, search, global sorting and complete export

lesson_bundle.reason: An administration performance fix needs real authenticated evidence
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Desktop/mobile initial load and every deferred section must work in the exact deployed release

predicted_rejections.rejection: Rows hidden but server still reads all contact payloads
predicted_rejections.prevention: Separate lightweight base, saved summaries, history and explicit detail requests
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Overview invokes no conversion, snapshot or history loader

predicted_rejections.rejection: Paging silently changes totals, sorting or export
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep complete filtered data for calculations and bound only rendered rows
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Find business beyond first50, sort globally, export every matching row

predicted_rejections.rejection: Old date or business response overwrites current context
predicted_rejections.prevention: Abort and scope asynchronous report/detail requests
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Delayed-response tests and real scope changes

predicted_rejections.rejection: Existing report tools disappear or loading zeros look real
predicted_rejections.prevention: Named sections with independent loading/error states and preserved commands
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All sections exercised without automatic supplier pulls

midpoint_gate.trigger: First lean handler and bounded UI slice before full build
checks: All rows and totals survive bounded rendering

attack_questions: Can business921 be found, sorted and exported?
Can a prior date response replace the current report?
Does overview still fetch contact detail or history?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact deployed authenticated desktop/mobile flows and DOM size
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Handler and client behavior tests plus regression baseline

effectiveness.baseline: Observed v796:921 business rows and23727 DOM nodes plus automatic first-business detail fetch; precise request timing unavailable
effectiveness.target: Overview below3000 DOM nodes, business page at most50rows and no eager contact/history/provider requests
